label: GO after an unrewarded common a1->S1 trial, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (no D1/D2 activity) and almost only when the previous trial went unrewarded (prev_reward==0 covers 99.8% of activations, but precision is just 0.09). It is specific to the previous trial being a1 with a common transition to S1 (74% of mass), the common-unrewarded case where a model-based agent should switch. It is also strongly gated by time in the episode: silent before trial ~30, rising through trials 80-89 (ep_trial>=50 gives 98% of mass). The magnitude is higher when the model value is low (5.2-7.1). The remaining ~26% of mass comes from GO after unrewarded trials of other kinds (for example common a2->S2), mostly at low magnitude. It does not fire after rewarded trials. Every variable in the predicate is observed (previous trial outcome, plus episode time), so there are no future variables. Dev F1 0.65, precision 0.68, recall 0.63.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u, ?) and trial before (GO: a1 S1 u, a1 S2 r, a2 S2 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=8, phase=GO & ep_dec=7, phase=GO & ep_dec=9.
